description: Defines profiler configuration enums, structs, and classes for PyTorch's internal profiling system, including activity types, profiler states, experimental configurations, and base classes for profiler state management.

classes.name: ExperimentalConfig
classes.description: Holds experimental profiling options such as metrics, events, and flags for CUDA sync, timestamp adjustments, and metadata exposure.

classes.name: ProfilerConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for the profiler, including state, experimental options, and serialization methods.

classes.name: ProfilerStateBase
classes.description: Base class managing the state of the profiler, including configuration, callback handling, and thread-local management.

methods.name: actToString
methods.description: Converts an ActivityType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: ExperimentalConfig::ExperimentalConfig
methods.description: Constructor for ExperimentalConfig, initializing profiling options.

methods.name: ExperimentalConfig::operator bool
methods.description: Returns true if the experimental config is enabled.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::ProfilerConfig
methods.description: Constructor for ProfilerConfig, setting profiler state and options.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::disabled
methods.description: Returns true if the profiler is disabled.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::global
methods.description: Indicates if the profiler is in global mode.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::pushGlobalCallbacks
methods.description: Determines if global callbacks should be pushed.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::ProfilerStateBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the profiler state with a given configuration.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::get
methods.description: Retrieves the profiler state, either global or thread-local.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::push
methods.description: Pushes a new profiler state onto the stack.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::pop
methods.description: Pops a profiler state from the stack, either global or thread-local.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::setCallbackHandle
methods.description: Sets a callback handle for the profiler.

methods.name: profilerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the profiler is enabled.

methods.name: profilerType
methods.description: Returns the current active profiler type.
